subject: Handover velocity checkpoint — Carenote onboarding
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Lena Park <lena@carenote.com>, Carenote Procurement <procurement@carenote.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Handover velocity checkpoint — Carenote onboarding

Team,

Thanks for moving quickly here — wanted to capture the current state so CS has full visibility before kickoff. High-level deal context below:

- Account: Carenote Health (mid-market, integrated care management)
- Contract: 12-month subscription + onboarding services; committed start: target go-live window July 20–22, 2026
- Commercial notes: customer signed with a 30% first-year discount; procurement is reviewing a redline'd SOW (attached v1.2).

Key expectations for Sales->CS handoff:
- Kickoff (customer-facing): July 1, 2026 @ 10:00 AM PT — 90min (intro, success plan, technical intake)
- Internal pre-call (CS + Eng): June 30, 2026 @ 3:00 PM PT
- Acceptance criteria: 1) API ingest test with sample payloads, 2) Latency under 300ms p50 for typical flows, 3) Two weeks of staging validation with key prompts and monitoring hooks

Outstanding risks / blockers:
- Procurement: final SOW sign-off + DocuSign. Procurement asked for a small data-residency clause (they prefer US-only) — legal will send redlines by end of week.
- Security: they asked for a SOC 2 evidence pack and an answer to a subset of security questionnaire items during the kickoff.
- Technical: Carenote plans to send a staging dataset and an API key; we need to confirm token rotation policy & role-based access mapping.

Immediate asks / owners:
- CS PM: Tessa Morgan to be primary onboarding lead (internal owner) — @Tessa please confirm.
- Technical intake / runbooks: Ben Carter to lead the tech intake and first-run staging test.
- E2E escalation: Karthik will remain as commercial escalation contact through acceptance.
- Attachments: Carenote_SOW_v1.2.pdf (attached), draft MAP (MAP_Draft.xlsx) for the kickoff.

Please reply with any changes to owners or if there are missing acceptance gates. Lena — copying you so procurement/legal can see the timeline and the items we'll ask for on day one.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachment: MAP_Draft.xlsx (Excel, 38KB)

Thanks Vanessa — clear and appreciated. Quick confirmation of the internal split: happy to own the tech intake and the first staging run. Action items from my side:

- I'll pull together a staging checklist and pre-populate the runbook steps for the July 1 session (will attach MAP_Draft.xlsx with tech tabs filled).
- Need final SOW (single source) — if procurement/legal pushes additional redlines, call those out in the HubSpot deal so we can track acceptance gates.
- I'll request the customer's API contract (expected by Tue) and a sample payload; if they don't provide the sample by Tue EOD we should push back on the staging window.

Tessa — confirm you can be primary CS PM and own weekly success cadence post-kickoff. I'll stay on the thread for staging and run the tech test.

Ben Carter

- Staging materials: we'll upload the sample payload and test dataset to the shared Drive by EOD Tue. Expect an S3 link.

We appreciate the ownership split. Looking forward to July 1.

1) Internal prep: scheduled 30 Jun 2026 @ 3:00 PM PT (30m) for CS + Eng to run through the MAP and the staging checklist. Invite sent to Ben and Karthik.
2) Kickoff agenda: I will circulate a 90min agenda for July 1 by EOD today with sections for success plan, tech intake, security Q&A, and timelines.
3) Risks I will track: procurement sign-off timeline, SOC 2 evidence turnaround, and dataset delivery. I'll create a short risk register in the HubSpot deal and add owners.
